name: The Montague on the Gardens Hotel
positioning: Traditionally English London hotel spread across nine connecting townhouses, just steps from the British Museum; part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection
best_for: Travelers who want a base steps from the British Museum and near Covent Garden and the West End
Families wanting family studios or multi-bedroom apartments

facts.text: The hotel is just steps from the British Museum.
The hotel is near Covent Garden and the West End's theatres.
The hotel is part of The Red Carnation Hotel Collection.
The hotel has antique hanging tapestries.
Every guest room and suite is individually designed.
Afternoon Tea is served in the conservatory overlooking the gardens.
The Leopard Bar has live jazz.
The hotel hosts beehives as part of its sustainability efforts.
Guests can learn champagne sabrage, opening a bottle with a cavalry sword.
The hotel runs seasonal pop-up experiences through the year.

highlights.text: The hotel offers private British Museum tours with early access before it opens to the public.
The hotel spreads across nine connecting townhouses.
The Bee and Honey Masterclass includes a garden eco-walk, candle making, honey tasting and afternoon tea overlooking the hotel's hives.
Multi-bedroom apartments have a private entrance and patio.
Rooms have Floris amenities, marble bathrooms and Savoir beds.

considerations.text: Interconnecting rooms must be booked directly through the reservations team.
WhataHotel notes compact room sizes typical of a historic Georgian building.
WhataHotel notes the traditional decor may feel dated to some modern travelers.
